about_the_game:
Step into the underground world of caves in the most realistic VR spelunking game, where the entire environment is your map, just waiting to be discovered.

🏋️‍♀️Beat environmental challenges: steep climbs, narrow tunnels and slides

🚩Mark your own clues on cave walls with chalk

🔨Clear your path of obstacles with a hammer

⛏️Climb walls and ceilings using ice axes

👨‍🔧Maintain your gear to ensure its reliability

👀 No cheap horror tricks – just a mysterious and immersive cave atmosphere

🕹️ Multiple gameplay modes: contemplative Story, fast Arcade racing, scary Horror & educational Tourist

Story Mode

Follow the story of Jake, who is retracing the footsteps of his father — a famous spelunker — and uncover family secrets as he descends deeper into the abyss of the caves. No cheap jump scares - the main game fear factors are headlamp battery life and well… your nerves!

Horror Mode

A separate standalone mode when you navigate unfamiliar sections of the cave with limited tools while facing potential threats. Intended for users seeking a tense and frightening experience, this mode unlocks after completing the first chapter of the Story Mode.

Tourist Mode

Immerse yourself in the visuals and atmospheric soundtrack at their own pace. The mode includes visiting the famous Nutty Putty cave with audio guide by rescuer Brandon Kowallis.

Arcade Mode (coming soon after the premiere)

Race against time by climbing, swinging, and scrambling your way through challenging routes — while hitting every checkpoint with precision. Different maps with fitness-fueled challenges, built for adrenaline junkies and speedrunners alike.

Gameplay Features

  • Realistic Cave Layouts: Irregular, natural cave structures that avoid repetition or tiled environments.

  • Detailed Environmental Interaction: Players can move rocks, observe dripping water, and interact with reactive surroundings.

  • No Built-in Map System: Players must mark trails with chalk, promoting true exploration and self-reliance.

  • Free Climbing Mechanics: Climb any surface, choosing your own routes—no predefined climbing paths.

  • Breath Management System: Manage your breathing in tight passages. Underwater cave diving, tied to this system, arrives in the upcoming free updates.

  • Obstacle Interaction: Use tools to break stalactites, remove debris, and clear blockages in the cave system.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX1060 / AMD Radeon RX580
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, Meta Quest or PlayStation VR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, Meta Quest or PlayStation VR

short_description: Visit real caves - like legendary Nutty Putty (with audio guide by rescuer Brandon Kowallis!) - and fictional ones, each offering a different kind of challenge! Step into the underground world in the most realistic spelunking game, where the entire environment is your map waiting to be discovered!
